title: Scripts get re-ordered even when "Sort Scripts By" setting is set to "None"
body:
### Tested versions

Noticed in v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e].

Cannot test other versions, but suspect it happened in previous stable versions too.

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on X11 - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility)

### Issue description

When `text_editor/script_list/sort_scripts_by` is set to `None`, the script list still gets re-ordered upon closing and re-opening a project.

I'd expect the script list to remain in the order it was when I closed the project.

Perhaps it's re-ordered so that the script attached to the currently-open scene is at the top of the list. But this doesn't happen when switching between scenes/scripts with the project open, so I don't see why it should happen when closing and re-opening a project...

See screencast for example:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d1398246-8cc0-4c87-8729-d37429772a01)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open attached MRP
2. Go to Editor > Editor Settings > Text Editor > Script List
3. Enable Advanced Settings
4. Set "Sort Scripts By" to "None"
5. Close settings window
6. Go to the Script tab
7. Drag the `global.gd` script to the top of the list (above `test.gd`)
8. Go to Project > Reload Current Project
9. Note `global.gd` is below `test.gd`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[sort_scripts_by.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25411962/sort_scripts_by.zip)
